title: W2 The Community page: wall, composer, moderation, Space capability set

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: Space circles become a Community wall; thread plan /mnt/project-files/community-wall/PLAN.md

detail:
/spaces/[slug]/community (tab beside Circles) built from the Circles handoff: cover, What's on, sticky tabs, arrivals strip, composer (Photo, Poll, Ask, Announce for team), post cards with replies and high fives, pinned posts, side column (About, Circles, How we meet, Who's here). Wall settings for the owner. Moderation: pin, hide, lock replies, remove, ban from the wall, Space report queue. New space.* capabilities for the Space team ladder. Signed-out and private-wall states. Render at 390, 768, 1440 and 2000 beside the design before merge. SLICE 1 SHIPPED (2026-11-03, PR 4550): space_wall_feed read RPC (migration 20270346028900), the Community page with composer, wall posts and topic Circles list, the Community tab, wall reply and high-five gating (canInteractOnWall), /community to /circles redirect removed. STILL OPEN here: owner wall settings and moderation page, fuller side column from the mock, Space calendar block, mention and gamification fan-out for wall posts.

Shipped in PR 4550: space_wall_feed RPC, Community page (wall, composer, About and Who's here, What's Happening, topic Circles), Community tab, wall reply and reaction gating, owner console /manage/community (read, post, followers settings; pin, hide, bring back). Arrivals strip, Poll/Ask/Announce, ban and the report queue split to LIVE-2095.
